life.lead: Built in 2003, The Heights is a gated community on Carmel Country Road with tile roofs, stucco exteriors and mature palms. Most homes are recorded as condominiums in the MLS, even though the community is often called a townhome community, and they range from 1-bedroom starter homes to 3-bedrooms of more than 1,400 sq ft. See the full The Heights community profile.
reasons: A controlled-access entrance and well-kept grounds give it a private, settled feel.
Carmel Valley Middle School is about 5 minutes on foot, and Del Mar Highlands Town Center about 11.
With 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom homes, you can move up within the community instead of leaving it.

faq.q: What do homes at The Heights sell for?
What are the monthly dues at The Heights?
faq.a: MLS listings from 2025 and 2026 show $392–$485 a month, varying by unit. The fee covers the gated entrance, pool, spa, fitness center, clubhouse, landscaping and exterior maintenance. Confirm the current fee for a specific unit.
Yes. Most recent listings show a Mello-Roos (Community Facilities District) assessment of about $389–$675 a year on top of the regular property tax. Ask for the exact figure on a unit's tax bill.

faq.q: Are homes at The Heights townhomes or condos?
faq.a: The community is often called a townhome community, but most homes are recorded as condominiums in the MLS. Ask about the specific floor plan and what the association insures before you make an offer.

faq.q: How big are the homes at The Heights?
faq.a: 1-bedrooms are about 770–800 sq ft, 2-bedrooms about 1,145–1,244 sq ft, and 3-bedrooms about 1,130–1,444 sq ft.

faq.q: Is The Heights a gated community?
faq.a: Yes. The Heights has a controlled-access gated entrance.

faq.q: How quickly do homes at The Heights sell?
faq.a: About 6 homes a year have sold here over the last 5 years, with a median of about 3 weeks on the market.

Most listings show Carmel Del Mar Elementary (Del Mar Union), Carmel Valley Middle School and Torrey Pines High School (San Dieguito Union); some show Carmel Creek Elementary instead. Canyon Crest Academy is a district-wide option. Confirm with each district for a specific address.
